data.for_supervisor: VERDICT: ✅ All 4 issues fixed. System prompts are now embedded in the message using [SYSTEM]/[MESSAGE] format since opencode run has no --system-prompt flag. Retry logic added: up to 2 retries on non-zero exit, JSON parse failure, or no text events, with raw output included in final error. JSON parser now concatenates all type:text events (not just the last one). Timeout increased to 60s. Edge cases (empty messages, no user message) handled. TypeScript compiles clean (pre-existing supertest/types error in test file is unrelated).
